unit.why: A letter copied by the compiler, from R. Pinchas of Koretz (Shapira of Ostroh) to R. Yeshaya of Dinovitz, answering his questions with kabbalistic and halakhic explanations and interpreting his vision of the verse 'כולך יפה רעיתי'. Its brief mentions of nightly visionary experience frame the teaching and do not form a narrative.
